reviews.text:

This is NOT CUSTOMIZED It may provide options that could possibly create personal “tailoring” with its categorical choices, but it still forces you into ignorant, poorly educated, lack of thinking, multiple-choice, conformity, but it certainly is NOT “customized”. 

Right from the start where it asks what your goal is nothing aligns with the reason I was going to use the app! On American and Indian (hugely closed- minded poorly educated  conformists) apps that rarely does, they’re such a massive conformity and lack of individual thought. reviews.title: False Advertisement!!
reviews.text: False Advertisement!! I just watched 2 different ads that claim it’s free but when you click on the links, it takes you to the same series of questions. Then after they get you to put your email address in, they show you your “Personalized Plan” and several different choices of how much you want to pay. None of them say free! I screen recorded the false advertising and took screenshots to prove my claims!! I’m tired of the tricks and scams just to get people to click on their links.

reviews.title: 6mos to loose 10lbs
reviews.text: Videos are sped up & looped, It’s hard to mimic what they’re doing because of this sometimes. The app completely forgot my goal, the plans are awful. I wanted to lose 10 lbs by September, I started in July. I’m 166. Most plans are 28 days long which is terrible. I’ve finished two plans, the ones that were 7 days long, I gained 3 pounds and after choosing the personal plan option they chose a plan for me that’s nearly 6 months long. 6 months to loose 10 lbs. What a joke. I even paid for the subscription. Save your bucks.

reviews.title: AI with no QA
reviews.text: Shocker that my last review isn’t shown. This is just AI slop and the “developers” should probably start actually using the app instead of having users pay money to be alpha testers. Today the “trainer” was missing an arm and then also levitating later. Tons of exercises have zero continuity in camera angle switching and pace. The integration with Apple Watch sucks as it gets stuck and doesn’t update the heart rate, and mostly resets the kcals burned. Most of my workouts that claim 200-300 kcals report 11-40 from my watch. I’m kicking myself that I bought a year subscription because a friend had it. Should have stuck with the other AI program that appeared to be tested better. Every workout just makes me angry.

reviews.title: Lied To…
reviews.text:
I was lied to about a 7-day free trial. I subscribed due to that reason, but was immediately charged. If you plan on actually using this app and have no problem paying for it first then this is the app for you. But if you’re like me and need a few days before making a decision, skip this one because they’ll lie to get you to subscribe and take your money immediately.

Update: I got the generic response stating that all refund requests are through Apple. I then reached out to the email provided and was given a longer explanation of how it’s all on Apple. And they also gave me a step-by-step instruction on how to go through Apple for the refund request! My stance still remains - avoid this lying scammy app if you want to try a free 7-day trial. They will take your money immediately and Apple will refuse to refund it with no explanation other than it’s final.

reviews.title: They got rid of a lot of options
reviews.text: There used to be a lot of workout options with a variety of levels, amount of time, and choices of workout. They had dance workouts, yoga, chair, bed, focusing on different body parts, and generic fat burn. They offered anywhere from 14-day to 28-day workouts. Some of them took under 10 minutes, others were under 20. It used to be great. Now I have four options and their “customized” option, which starts out too easy and gets too difficult and too long very quickly. I hope they put back all of the workout options soon.

reviews.title: Charged without warning
reviews.text: If you decide to do the low cost trial., Be sure to put a reminder in your phone to cancel it. They charge you the renewal without any warning to give you a minute to go and cancel the subscription. For me, this app was a waste of money because I never even used it, and unlike the majority of apps where you either get something from the app itself or from Apple Pay telling you that you’re gonna have it renewed, there was nothing. Suddenly a $95 charge in my bank account.. For that much money, you may as well go get a gym membership.

reviews.title: Awful customer service
reviews.text:
I initially downloaded this app as it was advertised as a free trial, however I never actually came to use it or had any intentions to even pay for any subscriptions, I was charged multiple times just for downloading the app from my Apple Pay, they have taken multiple payments from my Apple Pay (credit card linked to my Apple Pay) which then was a red flag for me, I instantly reached out to JustFit to challenge all the charges they have taken from me all in one day (22/04/2026) 
£6.93
£9.99
£5.99
£4.99
£29.99
£29.99
TOTAL = £87.88, 
Then credit card charges for the transactions that just fit has taken has taken me up to a charge of £26.28 on top of the £87.88, which now takes my total losses to £114.16. I have been emailing JustFit to try and resolve this matter and get my money back, I haven’t got anywhere with them what so ever, every response I have had from them is that they can’t locate any of these payments, despite I have sent all the prove they have asked for and still they are still unable to help me, I’ve emailed several times with bank statements showing they have taken all this money from me in one day and they still can’t locate it. The statements clearly state “AY1_help.justfit.app” it shows my last 4 digits of the card they took the money from, yet I’m still getting nowhere with these. I have taken it up with my bank now as they have caused me so much distress. Please be very careful and cautious of using this app.
